candidate_enumeration.definition: (List.range n).flatMap fun m => (List.range (n - m)).map fun k => <m, k + 1>
candidate_enumeration.order: baseIndex crescente; para cada baseIndex, period crescente

enumeration_characterization.route: rcases, simp only [cycleCandidates, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range, CycleWitness.mk.injEq], constructor, omega

partial_detector.signature: detectCycleWitness? {X} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (f : X -> X) (x : X) : Option CycleWitness
partial_detector.body: (cycleCandidates (Fintype.card X)).find? fun w => decide (CycleWitness.Valid f x w)

soundness.route: unfold; List.find?_some com predicado explicito; of_decide_eq_true
soundness.reason: as tres cotas ja pertencem a Valid
soundness.issue_encountered: unificacao de ordem superior escolhia @decide (Valid f x w) como funcao constante; resolvido passando (p := fun v => decide (Valid f x v))

completeness.route: exists_bounded_iterate_collision -> CycleWitness <mu, lam> -> mem_cycleCandidates_iff -> decide -> List.find?_isSome -> Option.isSome_iff_exists

collision_reuse: exists_bounded_iterate_collision aplicado diretamente; conclusao coincide termo a termo com Valid

empty_type.argument: o detector recebe x : X; nao ha chamada bem tipada em tipo vazio; cycleCandidates 0 = [] nao contradiz a completeness

periodicity_bridge: CycleWitness.isPeriodicPt := periodic_tail_of_collision f x h.2.2.2 — uma linha, sem prova nova
periodicPts_bridge: CycleWitness.mem_periodicPts := Function.mk_mem_periodicPts h.2.1 (isPeriodicPt h) — sem minimalPeriod
propagation_bridge: CycleWitness.propagates := collision_propagates f x h.2.2.2 k — assinatura identica, iterate_add_apply nao aparece
